about: Free, permissively licensed tools and open-licence media sources Hathor's video pipeline can use. Paths are relative to GEN_HOME (the CPU worker's generation home). cpuSecondsPerUnit measured on the shared 18-core CPU worker (2026-09-29), warm, per 768x512 image or per stated unit.

cutout.does: background removal: cut a character out of its render to composite into a scene
cutout.licence: rembg MIT; isnet-general-use / u2net models Apache-2.0

depthParallax.does: 2.5D camera move from one still: depth estimate, then near pixels move more than far ones
depthParallax.licence: Depth-Anything-V2-Small Apache-2.0 (the Base/Large checkpoints are CC BY-NC — not used)
depthParallax.unit: 6-second 24 fps shot (11.5 s depth + 2.6 s frames)

upscale.does: 4x super-resolution (768x512 -> 3072x2048, fitted to a target size)
upscale.licence: Real-ESRGAN weights BSD-3-Clause; spandrel loader MIT
upscale.unit: image — expensive on CPU: use for thumbnails and hero shots, not every frame

interpolate.does: motion-compensated frame interpolation for smooth slow motion (ffmpeg minterpolate)
interpolate.unit: second of 48 fps output from 12 fps input

kenBurns_crossfade_captions.does: pans, crossfades, burned-in captions, optional Piper narration (existing)
kenBurns_crossfade_captions.licence: our code; FFmpeg LGPL; Piper MIT (voices per model card)

posePuppets.does: pose-driven character motion, look morphs, peoples crossfades (existing)

transcribe.unit: second of audio (about 10x faster than real time)

notUsed.RIFE: not installed yet — Practical-RIFE (MIT) ships its model code outside pip; ffmpeg minterpolate covers interpolation for now
notUsed.Coqui XTTS-v2: excluded — Coqui Public Model License is non-commercial
notUsed.Stable Video Diffusion: excluded — SVD community licence restricts commercial use above a revenue threshold; revisit
notUsed.ElevenLabs / Runway / Pika: paid APIs — belong in the product's bring-your-own-key slots, not built in

media.licence: CC0 / PDM / CC BY / BY-SA per item (NC/ND filtered out)
PD / CC0 / CC BY / BY-SA per file

media.source: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access

media.licence: items marked 'No known restrictions on publication' only
items with a PD/CC0 licenseurl only

mediaModule: integrations/media-sources.mjs — search(query, {type, licence: 'pd'|'cc0'|'cc-by', limit}) -> [{url, thumb, title, creator, licence, attribution, source, page}]
